'''Aranya''' is a spider [[NPC]] found within a cave in {{Zone|The Wasteland}} on the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.

== Quest ==
'''Aranya''' will make a deal with the player, stating that if they bring her a player with no [[Armor]] on, she will eat them, and in return the player will receive one {{Item|Chyme}}. The player can sacrifice themselves, but they will not receive any {{Item|Chyme}} for doing so. This can only be done once a week.

'''Corm''' is an [[NPC]] near {{zone|The Bastion}} that tells the story of the Great Dragons.

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | None
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Are you a tourist?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: This is my favorite site, I know everything about the great &5Dragons&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: This is of course &5Jythar&f, the Eternal One.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: The dragon army attacked our dimension many centuries ago and sent the world into pieces.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: The skeleton of &5Chozon&f can be seen on the island south of here. He was one of the generals of Jythar.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Dogen, Kirva, and Daydro perished and fell in the void, to my knowledge.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: The 4 generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: What even was their purpose?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I think they decided to break the world to weaken us, and by us I mean everyone in this dimension.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Despite the wars raging at the time, we were still able to unite and beat this common enemy.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Jythar knew there would be no path to victory against us for as long as we could unite.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: But why not retreat?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Why did he keep attacking us until his death?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I doubt it was madness. Dragons live for millennia, their Emperor surely wasn't mad.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: So why would he give up his life to guarantee a potential victory in the future?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: It's impossible for us to know, but we can theorize.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: It is known from the Dragons summoned nowadays that they worship their &5Queen&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Queen, Empress - the exact word might have been lost in translation.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I think Jythar did it for her.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I think the reason is &5love&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Maybe I am wrong, but I choose to believe it.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: This titan next to us is known by many names, some call them the &5Calamity&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: They are the enemies, but if they are motivated by love, maybe we can communicate with them.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: What do you think? Am I too romantic, or did my explanation make sense?
}}
|}

== Trivia ==
*Based on Corm's dialogue, it seems that Dragons have a language.
*Corm's dialogue is the first mention of both [[Jythar]] and the [[Dragon Queen]], both of which had their lore expanded in later updates.

'''Grandpa Wolf''' is an [[NPC]] located in {{Zone|Grandpa Wolf's Cave}} within the {{Zone|Glacite Tunnels}}. He unlocks access to [[Frozen Corpses|Frozen Corpse Milestones]].

== Dialogue ==
{{DialogueGrammar}}
{| class="wikitable"
! colspan="2" class="ct" | Condition
! Dialogue
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Oh, &7<player>&f! I'm having a conundrum! There's so many corpses scattered around the &bGlacite Mineshafts&f, and so little time!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Tell you what, would you be willing to help me gather them all for me? I'll &6reward &7you handsomely!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: ...So long as I get to keep the corpses.
&eSelect an option: &a[Yes] &c[No]
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | Initially selecting {{Green|[Yes]}}
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Awesome! Okay, stand still real quick...
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: &f&o*sniff sniff*
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Okay, now I'm familiar with your &ascent&f!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Using my amazing power of smell, I'll track you as you move through the &bGlacite Mineshafts&f.
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: ...
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: You know what the &bGlacite Mineshafts &fare, right?
&eSelect an option: &a[Yes] &c[No]
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | Initially selecting {{Red|[No]}}
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Oh, that's okay.
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: My wife's not gonna be happy.
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Been out here for months without so much as a scrap to show for it...
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: You know, you're starting to look kinda &f&otasty&f...
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | Selecting {{Green|[Yes]}} after asking what Glacite Mineshafts are
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Great, the look on your face had me worried for a second!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Anyways, whenever you loot a &bFrozen Corpse&f, I'll come soon after to retrieve it.
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Come talk to me and I'll show you how many corpses we, the dream team, have gathered together!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: After reaching certain &bFrozen Corpse Milestones &fI'll even give you some useful stuff from my stash!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Here, take a look!
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | Selecting {{Red|[No]}} after asking what Glacite Mineshafts are
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Hmm, maybe you're not ready then, yet.
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: &bGlacite Mineshafts &fsometimes pop up while you're mining in the &bGlacite Tunnels&f.
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: If you enter one, you'll fine &bFrozen Corpses &fstrewn throughout the place - they're all that's left of some unfortunate dwarves from long ago!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Though they're not very talkative fellows on account of being dead 'n all, you can still have a rummage through their backpacks for some loot!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Now, why don't you go and find a &bGlacite Mineshafts &for two, and then come talk to me again when you're ready for us to partner up?
}}
|}

== UI ==
{{/UI}}

== Tips ==
*Players can use {{code|/viewfrozencorpsemilestones}} to access the milestone menu remotely.
*Players should unlock and max [[Heart_of_the_Mountain#Tier_10|Gifts from the Departed perk]] in [[Heart of the Mountain]] before progressing this milestone.

== Trivia ==
*The total cost of keys for maxed Frozen Corpse milestone is {{BZC|100 Umber Key|100 Tungsten Key|20 Skeleton Key}}.
* '''Grandpa Wolf''' is likely related to {{NPCSprite|Grandma Wolf}}.
**Both of them start their dialogue by introducing their respective conundrums to the player.
*The [[German Wolf Skin]] uses the same head as '''Grandpa Wolf'''.
*The {{Code|/viewfrozencorpsemilestones}} command can be used even without access to the {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}}.

&b✆ &2Junker Joel &fhas been added to your Abiphone's contacts! }} |} == Tips == *The best upgrade order for early game gear is generally the {{Item|Challenging Rod}}, followed by the equipment pieces of {{Item|Backwater Armor}}, and finally the armor itself. **{{Item|Salmon Armor}} provides better survivability, although {{Item|Backwater Armor}} provides higher {{Stat|scc}} and {{Stat|treasure chance}} for cheaper, along with increased damage against [[Sea Creatures]]. *Before obtaining a {{Item|Treasure Hook}}, equipping 2 pieces of {{Item|Bronze Hunter Armor}} or better will achieve a similar effect. == Trivia == {{Sectionstub}} * It cost {{Item|Rusty Coin|amount=1024}}, {{Item|Busted Belt Buckle|amount=124}}, and {{Item|Old Leather Boot|amount=12}}, along with {{Item|Bayou Water Orb|amount=1}} and {{Coins|10000}} to buy each items, with the exception of the {{Item|Treasure Bait}}. ** The {{Item|Hermit Crab Pet}} will cost an additional {{Item|Rusty Coin|amount=20}}, {{Item|Busted Belt Buckle|amount=8}} and {{Item|Old Leather Boot|amount=1}} to upgrade to {{Rarity|l|nolink=t}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Mar 12|[[File:Junker Joel.png|26px]] Added '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|2026/Mar 23|Added Abiphone Contact.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Removed {{Item|Travel Scroll to the Bayou}} from '''Junker Joel'''.|Reduced the {{Item|Rusty Coin}} cost of {{Item|Challenging Rod}} from {{Green|16}} to {{Green|8}}.}} |beta= {{History|2025/Mar 18|[[File:Junker Joel.png|26px]] Added '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|2025/Mar 19|Added {{Item|Treasure Hook}} to '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|0.24.3|Added Abiphone Contact.}} {{History|0.27.1|Removed {{Item|Travel Scroll to the Bayou}} from '''Junker Joel'''.|Reduced the {{Item|Rusty Coin}} cost of {{Item|Challenging Rod}} from {{Green|16}} to {{Green|8}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

{{Infobox/Character |quests = {{Quest|There are Dwarves?}} |location = [[Obsidian Sanctuary]] |location_page_description = Unlocks access to the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} and [[Heart of the Mountain]], after the player has reached {{Skill|Mining|15}} and brought 15 enchanted ore items. |x = 31.5 |y = 12 |z = 14.5 |location2 = [[Dwarven Village]] |location_page_description2 = Introduces the player to the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}}. |x2 = -38 |y2 = 200 |z2 = -119 }} '''Rhys''' is an [[NPC]] in the {{Zone|Obsidian Sanctuary}}, near the {{NPCSprite|Lift Operator}}. They give the player access to the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} and [[Heart of the Mountain]] after they reach {{Skill|Mining|12}} and in exchange for {{Green|15}} enchanted versions of any type of [[Ores]]. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Dialogue |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | First Interaction
Before {{Skill|mining|12}} | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &fSo you want to visit the &2Dwarven Mines&f? &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: You must prove yourself worthy of &5Heart of the Mountain&f... &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: You are no match for the Dwarves of the Deeper Caverns. &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: Come back when you are Mining Level XII! }} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | Before Giving [[Ores]] | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &fSo you want to visit the &2Dwarven Mines&f? &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &fYou must prove yourself worthy of &5Heart of the Mountain&f... &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: You must bring me some valuable materials that peak my interest. &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: I would like a total of 15 items. Any from this list will do: &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Redstone Dust &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Iron Ingot &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Coal &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Emerald &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Lapis Lazuli &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Diamond &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Gold Ingot }} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | Incorrect Items | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: That's not an item I'm looking for! &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: I would like a total of 15 items. Any from the list will do: &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Redstone Dust &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Iron Ingot &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Coal &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Emerald &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Lapis Lazuli &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Diamond &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: &8- &aEnchanted Gold Ingot }} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | Some Correct Items | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dRhys&f: Thank you for the items!}} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | Giving All 15 Any Enchanted [[Ores]] | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: Perhaps you are someone we can get along with after all. &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: I'll get your &5Heart of the Mountain&f. It's time for a visit! &e[NPC] &dRhys&f: Let's go together now. For future trips, remember the &bLift Operator&f. }} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | First Interaction
[[Dwarven Mines]] | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Rhys&f: Now that you have your &5Heart of the Mountain&r, you have access to all of the deeper areas of the mines! &e[NPC] Rhys&f: You can access the &5Heart of the Mountain &rfrom the Mining Skill menu, and unlock loads of powerful upgrades as you continue your journey! &e[NPC] Rhys&f: We Dwarves inhabit this area. We love it! It is rich in Mithril and even some Titanium. &e[NPC] Rhys&f: You will need a good pickaxe to mine ores here. For Mithril, at least something with a &aBreaking Power &rof 4. &5Bubu &rjust down the street could help you with that! &e[NPC] Rhys&f: If you're looking for better hardware, maybe try checking out the &6Forge&r. You could also visit the &bRoyal Palace &rto talk to the &6&lKing &rabout certain tasks! &e[NPC] Rhys&f: Enjoy our little slice of mining heaven! }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="3" | {{zone|The Garden}} | class="ct" | None | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRhys&f: I found an unexplored cave while mining for titanium. But it's too dark to see in there, even for me! Can you spare any glowing pumpkins?}} |- | class="ct" | Completing | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRhys&f: Thank you! Discovery awaits.}} |- | class="ct" | Denying | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRhys&f: Well then, I will even mine in total darkness if I must!}} |- ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Random Dialogue |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" colspan="2" | After Giving [[Ores]] | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dRhys&f: I had a sunburn once, I have stayed down there ever since.}} |- | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dRhys&f: You can ask the &bLift Operator &ffor a ride to the &2Dwarven Mines&f!}} |} == Tips == *The best ore to mine for '''Rhys'''{{'}}s quest to unlock the [[Dwarven Mines]] is {{Item|Redstone Ore|text=Redstone}}, since {{Green|640}} can be bought from the {{NPCSprite|Mad Redstone Engineer}} and it has a high base drop rate. **If the player wants to avoid being attacked by {{MobSprite|Redstone Pigman;Redstone Pigmen}}, {{Item|Lapis Lazuli Ore|text=Lapis Lazuli}} is a close second. == Trivia == *Completing '''Rhys'''{{'}}s quest grants the {{ach|Resourceful|ach=true}}. *When the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} update first launched, Rhys wouldn't take the items to complete his quest. This turned out to be a bug with the SkyBlock Addons mod, one of the most popular mods for SkyBlock. Before this was fixed in SkyBlock Addons, there were rumors that the Dwarven Mines had been disabled by the admins to fix bugs, which was untrue. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jul 15|Updated [[Crystal Hollows]] description in the '''Rhys'''{{'}}s menu.}} |beta= {{History|0.11|[[File:Rhys.png|26px]] Added '''Rhys'''.}} {{History|Unknown|Fixed being able to complete '''Rhys'''{{'}}s quest with 30 of the same item by switching lobbies.}} {{History|2026/Jul 22|Updated [[Crystal Hollows]] description in the '''Rhys'''{{'}}s menu.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Dwarven Mines/NPCs}} [[Category:Deep Caverns]]

source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Infobox/Character |location = [[Wyld Woods]] |location_page_description = Unlocks the {{Item|Montezuma Pet}}. |x = -122 |y = 120 |z = 137 }} '''Sad Jacquelle''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Wyld Woods}} who unlocks the {{Item|Montezuma Pet}}. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | First Interaction |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: The Argofays have been so kind to welcome me in one of their huts. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: It's been rough since I lost my &9cat&f. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: It just left my sight! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I think it's playing around the &5Rift&f! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Find my cat &9Montezuma&f! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Open my &6chest&f and take my &9Cat Detector&f! }} |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Opening chests inside her house |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Not that chest! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: That's where I store all the pictures of little Monte! }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Uh... it's not that one either. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I was talking about the one behind me, silly! }} |- | class="ct" | Claiming [[Cat Detector]] |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Now please go and find my dear &9Montezuma&f!}} |- | class="ct" | Returning
{{DG|Found Montezuma}} |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Hey you're back! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Did you find &9Montezuma&f? &eSelect an option: &a[I'm sorry but your cat is dead.] }} |- | class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[I'm sorry but your cat is dead.]}} |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: ... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I know that! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I'm so glad you found him! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: It's soul fractured into &99 parts&f when we crossed into the &5Rift&f. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I've been living in this cabin with 1\/9th of &9Montezuma&f for an eternity now. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Find all parts of &9Montezuma&f's soul so I can enjoy a full cat again! &eYou unlocked the &9Montezuma &epet in your SkyBlock Menu! }} |- | class="ct" | Without All [[Montezuma]] Soul Pieces |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Have you found all of &9Montezuma&r's soul yet?}} |- | class="ct" | Found All [[Montezuma]] Soul Pieces |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: You found all the pieces of &9Montezuma&f's soul? &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: That's amazing! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I'll level with you now. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I'm still &9sad&f. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: But it's because I'm stuck in an alternate reality... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: With nowhere to go... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: And nothing to do... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I can't sleep and yet I can't get out of bed. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: So how are you doing? }} |} == Trivia == Clicking on {{Rmt|&a[I'm sorry but your cat is dead.]}} plays a wither sound. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2023/May 4|[[File:Sad Jacquelle.png|26px]] Added '''Sad Jacquelle'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.19|[[File:Sad Jacquelle.png|26px]] Added '''Sad Jacquelle'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Are you a tourist?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: This is my favorite site, I know everything about the great &5Dragons&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: This is of course &5Jythar&f, the Eternal One.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: The dragon army attacked our dimension many centuries ago and sent the world into pieces.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: The skeleton of &5Chozon&f can be seen on the island south of here. He was one of the generals of Jythar.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Dogen, Kirva, and Daydro perished and fell in the void, to my knowledge.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: The 4 generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: What even was their purpose?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I think they decided to break the world to weaken us, and by us I mean everyone in this dimension.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Despite the wars raging at the time, we were still able to unite and beat this common enemy.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Jythar knew there would be no path to victory against us for as long as we could unite.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: But why not retreat?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Why did he keep attacking us until his death?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I doubt it was madness. Dragons live for millennia, their Emperor surely wasn't mad.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: So why would he give up his life to guarantee a potential victory in the future?
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: It's impossible for us to know, but we can theorize.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: It is known from the Dragons summoned nowadays that they worship their &5Queen&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Queen, Empress - the exact word might have been lost in translation.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I think Jythar did it for her.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: I think the reason is &5love&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: Maybe I am wrong, but I choose to believe it.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: This titan next to us is known by many names, some call them the &5Calamity&f.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: They are the enemies, but if they are motivated by love, maybe we can communicate with them.
&e[NPC] &dCorm&f: What do you think? Am I too romantic, or did my explanation make sense?
}}

'''Tasty Mithril''' is an {{Uncommon}} item that can be obtained during the [[Dwarven Mines#Mithril Gourmand|Mithril Gourmand]] event.

== Obtaining ==
'''Tasty Mithril''' has a {{Green|30%}} chance to drop from [[Mithril|Mithril Ore]] during the [[Dwarven Mines#Mithril Gourmand|Mithril Gourmand]] event in specific areas of the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}}. The area that players need to mine in is announced at the beginning of the event and is displayed in the sidebar.

== Usage ==
'''Tasty Mithril''' can be fed to {{NPC|Don Expresso}} during the [[Dwarven Mines#Mithril Gourmand|Mithril Gourmand]] event. Doing so will grant various rewards to the player.


== Trivia ==
* Feeding {{NPC|Don Expresso}} '''Tasty Mithril''' for the first time will reward the player with the {{ach|A Good Review|ach=true}}.
* If {{NPC|Don Expresso}} is fed '''Tasty Mithril''' from a previous event, it will be wiped from the player's inventory without counting toward the event, with the following dialogue:
blocks.payload_raw:
&e[NPC] &bDon Expresso&f: THIS OLD MITHRIL IS STALE! DON'T EVER FEED THIS TO ME AGAIN!
&c# Tasty Mithril pieces were removed from a different event!
